edges.reason: balances mapping is indexed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
msg.sender supplies the source balance checked and debited in transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance lookup inside transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner when approve is called.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
The authorization predicate require(msg.sender == owner) reads the owner state variable.
owner state gates execution of transferOwnership through the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership mutates the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates the privileged transferAnyERC20Token function.
Caller supplied tokenAddress determines the target of the privileged external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount of the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an unchecked external call on an arbitrary token contract.
External call into a caller-controlled token contract can reenter the token and repeat the withdrawal path.
_to parameter is used as the transfer recipient.
_value parameter is used as the transferred amount.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer debits balances using SafeMath.sub.
transfer credits balances using SafeMath.add.
_from parameter determines the debited balance in transferFrom.
_to parameter determines the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter determines the amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
_spender parameter receives the new allowance in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance entries are keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
_owner parameter selects the allowance record read by allowance.
_spender parameter selects the allowance record read by allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_owner parameter selects the balance record read by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.

parameter b feeds the multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.

parameter a is the minuend in SafeMath.sub.

parameter a is the first addend in SafeMath.add.
parameter b is the second addend in SafeMath.add.
SafeMath.add computes a + b, the overflow-sensitive operation.
Local c stores the sum produced inside SafeMath.add.
